name: Blokkit
description:
About This Game

Drop a piece on the board, and every cell it covers flips. Light the whole board to win. That's all there is to it!

Blokkit is a stress-free and tactile logic puzzle about placing chunky blocks on small boards. Each level hands you a fixed set of pieces and a board to light up. Pieces flip whatever they touch but the puzzle is never where a piece fits, it's what order and what overlap leave every tile activated.

Nine different worlds

Your journey runs from Meadow to the Finale through 81 puzzles of increasing complexity. Worlds introduce new board shapes and new mechanics:

  • Frozen cells that soak up the first cover before they'll flip

  • Coupled cells that flip their partner too

  • Boards that wrap around the edges

  • Pieces that spin after every move

  • Conveyor belts that shift the board while you work

One board for the whole world

Every day there is one seeded Daily Puzzle, identical for everyone, everywhere. You get a single attempt, ranked by time on a global leaderboard. Keep your streak alive and see how your morning coffee solve stacks up.

Puzzles that never run out

Finish a world and its Endless Mode opens: infinitely generated boards built from that world's mechanics, perfect for winding down. Feeling up for a challenge? Endless Arcade starts a time bank where every solve buys you more seconds, boards keep coming, and mechanics stack up until the clock finally wins. Then if you really want to wind down, the Endless Zen mode provides endless puzzles, built to your own design, without timers or goals.Â Â 

Made to feel good

  • 81 puzzles across 9 colorful worlds

  • Solvable with logic

  • A Daily Puzzle

  • Endless generated puzzles for every world you finish

  • Endless Arcade time-bank runs to challenge yourself

  • Endless Zen mode with no time limits and your own selection of size and mechanics to destress yourself

  • Unlimited undo, instant restarts, no timers outside arcade

  • Full controller support

  • Full Steam Deck support
short_desc: Drop pieces, flip tiles, light up the whole board. A cozy, tactile logic puzzle where every placement flips the cells it covers. Settle in for 81 handcrafted puzzles across 9 gentle-to-tricky worlds, share one daily board with the whole world, or unwind with endless puzzles in zen or arcade mode.
